settings_privacy_intro.message: How Yiveno handles your memories, ownership, optional sync, and AI.

settings_privacy_bullet_export.message: Full backup export (Data section) is always available — a product responsibility, not a paid feature.

settings_privacy_bullet_cloud.message: Cloud (optional): uploaded only after you turn sync on.
